_comment: In-mission NPC conversations. Flag names match assets/data/story.json so a talk here changes the cutscenes and the endings.

n1.speaker: marcus
n1.name: MARCUS
n1.text: You're Elena. Seventh floor. I've watched you come home at three in the morning for two years.

n2.speaker: marcus
n2.text: I'm not going down there. But the bag by the rail is yours. Flashlight, batteries, a little food. Take it.

n3.speaker: marcus
n3.text: You want the truth or you want the stairs?

choices.text: Ask him about the night it started
Tell him to come with you

n4.speaker: marcus
n4.text: My wife went to the hospital on the second day. She never called. I keep the door locked now, and I keep the lights off. That's the whole story.

n5.speaker: marcus
n5.text: Go. And if you see a woman in a green coat, tell her I waited. She'll know what it means.

n6.speaker: marcus
n6.text: With these knees? I'd be your second death tonight. Go on. I'll keep the door shut.

n1.speaker: stranger
n1.name: THE MAN FROM 5C
n1.text: Please. Don't. I'm not bit. I swear on my mother, I'm not bit — I just fell on the stairs.

n2.speaker: stranger
n2.text: He's holding his left arm against his chest like it belongs to someone else.

choices.text: Shine the flashlight on his arm

n3.speaker: stranger
n3.text: The light finds the bite. A crescent of teeth through the sleeve, black at the edges. He sees you see it. His jaw clicks, once.

n4.speaker: stranger
n4.text: His hand closes around your wrist. Too strong. Too cold. The thing that used to be the man from 5C stands up.

n1.speaker: garcia
n1.name: GARCIA
n1.text: That's far enough. Hands where I can see them. I've shot three people this week who moved too fast.

n2.speaker: garcia
n2.text: So. What's the story, and make it a short one.

choices.text: Tell him the truth about the kid's bite

n3.speaker: garcia
n3.text: A bite. On a kid. And you drove him here instead of leaving him on the shoulder. Huh.

n4.speaker: garcia
n4.text: Then you're not lying, and that's worth more than the shells. Take these. Point it at the dead, not at me.

n5.speaker: garcia
n5.text: A scratch. Sure. You keep that story and I'll keep my eyes on you.

n1.speaker: priya
n1.name: PRIYA
n1.text: Don't touch the shelves. Garcia counts every can and he counts them again at night.

n2.speaker: priya
n2.text: You look like you want to ask me something. Everyone does.

n3.speaker: priya
n3.text: Sofia was my sister. She was out there when the highway closed. If you found her, say it fast.

n4.speaker: priya
n4.text: Nine of us made it to this station. Four since. Garcia does the math out loud so nobody forgets it.

n5.speaker: priya
n5.text: Then don't tell me. I've had enough of that word for one year.
